messages:
ryna: Opening a tiny docs PR for private/VPC install UX: link fixes, an SDK snippet for KMS auth, and an appendix on HSM vendor paths. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620 :wave:
omar: linking. Can you include an example that shows how the SDK should load the KMS CA bundle and fallback to system store? SEs paste the wrong flags all the time.
ryna: added this short Node example in the PR: `const client = new KMSClient({ ca: fs.readFileSync('/etc/redwood/kms-ca.pem') || undefined })` with a short note to prefer the bundle when using vendor CAs.
kat: nice. For the HSM appendix, can we include a Luna example (different from Thales) so customers see multiple vendors? Also call out /opt/lunaclient/lib vs /usr/lib differences.
ryna: good idea. Added a one-paragraph Luna note and a tiny probe: `pkcs11-tool --module /opt/lunaclient/lib/lunaclient_pkcs11.so -L` and a search fallback: `find / -name '*pkcs11*.so' 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'luna|yubico|thales' || true`
omar: in the networking checklist, replace the usual sha256 examples with a sha512 variant for the larger images we ship. Eg: `curl -fSLO https://mirror.redwood.internal/release-2026-08/images.tar.gz && curl -fSLO https://mirror.redwood.internal/release-2026-08/images.tar.gz.sha512 && sha512sum -c images.tar.gz.sha512`
kat: also add a short note about SELinux contexts on RHEL: `restorecon -Rv /etc/hsm` and a troubleshooting pointer when files are blocked.
ryna: added both. I also pasted a minimal iptables->nft translation snippet since some customers run mixed stacks: `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8443 -j ACCEPT` -> `nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 8443 accept`
omar: small UX nit: change "expose certs" wording. Legal flagged it last quarter. Use: "KMS must present a certificate chain signed by the customer's root CA; private key material must remain on the HSM or be restricted to the KMS host with appropriate ACLs."
ryna: updated wording across the PR. Also added an openssl SNI check for support: `openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:8443 -servername kms.local -showcerts` and a note about using `-servername` when proxying.
kat: QA bot flagged a broken internal link in the migration checklist that pointed to /vpc/old-install. Can you fix and add a redirect note?
ryna: fixed link and added a short redirect note for older bookmarks. Marked PR as docs:review and requested @omar and @kat.
docs-bot: PR 1620: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @omar, @kat.
qa-bot: docs-lint OK for changed files in PR 1620.
omar: I'll review tonight focusing on SDK snippet and HSM appendix. If it's wording + tiny snippets should be quick. :thumbsup:
ryna: thanks all. If reviewers approve I'll merge after green CI and backport a 1-line pointer into the migration checklist for SEs.
